answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one beacon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The nectar report reveals the merge explicitly at each canyon. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 71 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 188 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1205 identities would post 784 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
